paper.title_en: The double copy and perturbative teleparallel gravity
paper.abstract_en: In this paper we analyze the double copy between gluon and graviton amplitudes within the context of teleparallel gravity. We first set up an effective Lagrangian based on minimal assumptions which reproduces the on-shell amplitudes stemming from the double-copy procedure. By straightforwardly computing the three- and four-point amplitude, this double-copy Lagrangian can be constrained up to a few real parameters when expanding to quartic order. For a specific choice of parameters, we find an exact equivalence with perturbative teleparallel gravity. This suggests that the teleparallel formulation might be well suited to make the double copy more transparent from a Lagrangian viewpoint.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在微扰远平行引力框架下研究胶子与引力子振幅之间的双拷贝，并构造有效拉氏量以重现双拷贝壳上振幅，属于修改引力中的远平行引力方向，理论深度和方法信号尚可，值得点入进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 双拷贝与微扰远平行引力
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们在远平行引力的背景下分析了胶子与引力子振幅之间的双拷贝。我们首先在最小假设的基础上建立了一个有效拉氏量，它重现了源于双拷贝程序得到的壳上振幅。通过直接计算三点和四点振幅，当展开到四次阶时，该双拷贝拉氏量可以被约束到仅剩少数几个实参数。对于参数的某一特定选择，我们发现其与微扰远平行引力存在精确等价。这表明，远平行表述可能很适合从拉氏量视角使双拷贝变得更加透明。
